formula.armed: clamp((base * max(1 + sum(BaseMultiplier), 0) + sum(BaseFinalAddition)) * product(BaseFinalMultiplier) * otherBaseFinalScalar(attr), min, max)
formula.final: clamp(((armed + sum(Addition)) * max(1 + sum(Multiplier), 0) + sum(FinalAddition)) * product(FinalMultiplier) * otherFinalScalar(attr), min, max)

otherBaseAdd.AtkIncreaseFactorFromStr: (Str is main ? BattleConst.atkRateOfMain : 0) + (Str is sub ? BattleConst.atkRateOfSub : 0); likewise Agi, Wisd, Will

otherFinalScalar.Atk: 1 + sum over X in Str, Agi, Wisd, Will of floor(final X) * final AtkIncreaseFactorFromX

modifyAttributeTarget.Main: the owner's main attribute, when it has one
modifyAttributeTarget.Sub: the owner's sub attribute, when it has one

sources.raw: CharacterTable attributes row for the selected level and break stage; AttributeMetaTable defaultValue otherwise
sources.weapon: WeaponUpgradeTemplateTable baseAtk at the weapon level, as (Atk, BaseAddition)
sources.skills: SkillData cardAttributeModifier.attributeModifiers: attributeType, formulaItem (ModifierType), modifyAttributeType, param (blackboard key at the skill level)
sources.equipment: EquipTable equipAttrModifiers: attrType, modifierType, modifyAttributeType, attrValues
sources.coefficients: BattleConst atkRateOfMain, atkRateOfSub, efficiencyOfSTR, efficiencyOfAGI, efficiencyOfWISD, healerEfficiencyOfWILL, recoverEfficiencyOfWILL

evidenceBoundary.direct: Every method claim below is re-proved on the installed build: the base/armed/final calculators call the named modifier-array readers and other-attribute hooks, the hooks call the named BattleConst getters and main/sub fields, and the weapon reader walks WeaponUpgradeDetailList. ModifierType and ModifyAttributeType members are compared exactly.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: The arithmetic order in `formula` (initial values 0 for sums and 1 for multiplier sums and products, max(..., 0) on multiplier factors, Math.Floor on attributes before conversion, Math.Clamp to the per-attribute bounds, and the Main/Sub/All target selection) is a reviewed capstone reading of one build's method bodies. The stdlib decoder does not decode every SSE instruction, so a client update re-proves the call structure but not the arithmetic; review the bodies again when their hashes in the audit change.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Runtime-only modifier sources (combat buffs, gem terms, team effects) and the enhancement level that selects an equipAttrModifiers attrValues index are outside this contract.

Attributes._CalculateBaseAttributeValue.contract: Sums each modifier source's BaseAddition onto the raw value, adds the other-attribute base add, and clamps to the attribute bounds.

Attributes._CalculateArmedAttributeValue.contract: Applies base multipliers, base final additions and base final scalars to the base value, then the other-attribute base final scalar.

Attributes._CalculateFinalAttributeValue.contract: Applies additions, multipliers, final additions and final scalars to the armed value, then the other-attribute final scalar.

AttributeModifierLoader.GetBaseValue.contract: Returns BaseAddition, BaseMultiplier, BaseFinalAddition and BaseFinalScalar for one attribute, in that out-parameter order.

AttributeModifierLoader.GetValue.contract: Returns Addition, Multiplier, FinalAddition and FinalScalar for one attribute, in that out-parameter order.

Attributes._GetOtherAttributeBaseAdd.contract: Dispatches MaxHp to the Str conversion and the four AtkIncreaseFactorFrom* attributes to the main/sub factor helpers.

Attributes.GetHpBaseAddFromStrAttribute.contract: Multiplies the owner's Str value by BattleConst.efficiencyOfSTR.

Attributes.GetStrAtkFactorFromMainSubAtt.contract: Adds BattleConst.atkRateOfMain when Str is the main attribute and atkRateOfSub when it is the sub attribute.

Attributes._GetOtherAttributeFinalScalar.contract: For Atk, returns one plus the four attribute-derived ATK scalars.

Attributes.GetAtkFinalScalarFromStr.contract: Multiplies the floored Str value by the AtkIncreaseFactorFromStr attribute.

WeaponUtil.TryGetWeaponAttrModifierData.contract: Reads the weapon upgrade curve row for the level and emits its baseAtk as an (Atk, BaseAddition) modifier.
